snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

sources.name: CSL styles repository: International Journal of Molecular Sciences

requirements.rule: Abstract about 200 words at most, one paragraph without headings
requirements.quote: The abstract should be a total of about 200 words maximum.

requirements.rule: Three to ten keywords after the abstract
requirements.quote: Three to ten pertinent keywords need to be added after the abstract.

requirements.rule: Main text: Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and Methods, then optional Conclusions (Discussion may be combined with Results)
Back matter: Supplementary Materials, Author Contributions, Funding, Data Availability Statement, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, References
Numbered citations in square brackets, before the punctuation
requirements.quote: reference numbers should be placed in square brackets [ ], and placed before the punctuation.

requirements.rule: Figures, schemes and tables go in the main text, close to their first citation
requirements.quote: All Figures, Schemes and Tables should be inserted into the main text close to their first citation.

requirements.rule: Figures are inserted in the manuscript file
requirements.quote: All Figures, Schemes and Tables should be inserted into the main text close to their first citation.

requirements.rule: Supplementary items are named like "Figure S1: title"
Funding statement is included (or "This research received no external funding")
requirements.quote: This research received no external funding

requirements.rule: Conflicts of Interest section just before the reference list
Institutional Review Board and Informed Consent statements ("Not applicable." when there are no humans or animals)
requirements.quote: Informed consent was obtained from all subjects involved in the study.

requirements.rule: Figures at least 1000 pixels wide or high, or 300 dpi or higher
requirements.quote: minimum 1000 pixels width/height, or a resolution of 300 dpi or higher.

requirements.rule: Table text no less than 8 pt
requirements.quote: no less than 8 pt. in size.

requirements.rule: Generative AI use is stated in Acknowledgments: tool, version, purpose, and that the authors reviewed the output
Acronyms defined at first use in the abstract, the main text and the first figure or table
